stories.title: ICE employee gets favorable plea deal for underage sex sting
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors let Alexander Back plead guilty to "misprison of a felony" instead of a sex crime, sparing him sex offender registration.

stories.title: Hennepin County attorney charges Uber passenger with attempted murder but won’t seek bias enhancement
stories.summary: Mohamed Yusuf remains in critical condition, but prosecutors said they do not have sufficient evidence to prove bias was the motive for the attack.

stories.title: Erosion threatens graves at Scandia Cemetery
stories.summary: As Lake Superior warms and winter ice cover declines, waves are threatening graves at Scandia Cemetery.

stories.title: Fridley school board votes to approve an outside employee investigation after superintendent is put on leave
stories.summary: The move comes after mounting financial concerns and the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension agents raided district offices Friday.

stories.title: Police: Son accidentally shoots mother while cleaning gun
stories.summary: Police say the son called 911 to say he accidentally shot his mother.

stories.title: Busy week of outages has some Americans worried about a coordinated cyber attack, but experts say it's not likely
stories.summary: Amid widespread airline and banking disruptions, experts emphasize no cyberattack evidence has been discovered so far.

stories.title: After 25 years, U.S. loses measles elimination status
stories.summary: Healthcare experts say this is setback and will have to work to regain publics trust.

stories.title: Minnesota man stranded during ground stop rents U-Haul to get home
stories.summary: It wasn't comfortable, but it got the job done.

stories.title: Iconic structure in downtown Minneapolis to become hotel
stories.summary: One of the most recognizable buildings in downtown Minneapolis is being transformed into a 165-room hotel with a 15,000-square-foot subterranean spa and pool.

stories.title: Mall of America to attempt Guinness World Record during Black Friday celebration
stories.summary: On Friday, Nov. 27, the Mall of America will attempt to set the record for the most people holding up the same shopping bag simultaneously.

stories.title: Judge denies Vance Boelter's request to change location of state murder trial
stories.summary: The Court will summon 500 prospective jurors, significantly more than the usual 50.

stories.title: Uber passenger charged in brutal assault of Somali American driver in Hopkins
stories.summary: Mohamed Yusuf is in critical condition after suffering broken ribs, a broken leg, spinal injuries, collapsed lungs and internal bleeding from several organs.
